text:
Jules: Heads-up — Skyline Cloud invited us to a featured marketplace slot. They want co-marketing: listing, a short benchmark post, and a joint "how-to" webinar. Can we draft an execution sprint?

Ravi: I'll run the marketplace listing. Need logos, 1x hero image (1200x600), two-sentence product blurb, and a 60s demo link. Deadline request from Skyline: publish by May 28.

Emma (Skyline): We can provide the hero image and host the marketplace feature if assets are ready by May 20. Also can promote the webinar to our enterprise newsletter.

Maya: I'll do the benchmark narrative + blog. Suggest a short empirical section: cost/latency before/after using our caching + Skyline's edge routing for region-specific inference. Will need perf runs and sample request traces.

Ivy: I'll run webinar ops and promo. Proposed date: Tue May 26, 10am PT. Format: 30m demo + 20m panel + 10m Q&A. Need speakers and a moderator.

Sam (PO): I'll confirm speakers — can do a 15m product overview. Can we get a dev to run the demo?

ops-bot: Please complete the Marketplace Readiness checklist: assets, legal signoff, video, and UTM tags. Posting template in channel ops-templates.

Jules: Quick asks: (1) a 1-pager for sales (AE FAQ + top 5 objection responses), (2) lead routing map (marketplace -> Sales queue with partner tag), (3) a small social pack (3 posts): one announcement, one technical highlight, one webinar reminder.

Ravi: For lead routing, propose this mapping — share with ops team: 

```
source=partner_marketplace
partner=skyline_cloud
campaign=skyline_launch_may2026
lead_owner=BD_Partners
sfdc_queue=Partners_Skyline
utm_source=skyline_marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=skyline_launch_may2026
```

Maya: On benchmarks — I'll run end-to-end perf with and without KV caching and with Skyline's regional POPs. If we hit a >2x latency improvement on regional routing, that's a clear callout. Will post numbers by EOD Thu.

Ivy: Promo cadence: announcement (live now), webinar invite (2wks), webinar reminder x2 (3d, 1d), last-chance (1h). Can we confirm email owner?

Jules: Nate can own partner emails, right Nate?

Nate: Yep, I'll own partner emails + the landing page copy. Will need final headline + 3 bullets by Wed.

Sam (PO): Also small legal flag — Skyline requires a joint customer quote section; legal wants to pre-clear any named customer references. Sarah in legal can expedite if we loop her.

Jules: Good catch. Ivy — add legal touchpoint to the timeline.

Emma (Skyline): We also request a joint 60s video (co-branded). Skyline can record if you send a script and screen capture plan.

Ravi: Dev note — the marketplace's metadata schema requires a short technical tag list (model-support, latency-optimized, prefix-caching). I'll draft and post for review.

Maya: One more: For the blog's benchmark chart, can we include a small methodology blurb and sample queries? Keeps claims transparent.

Nate: I'll also prepare the AE one-pager template with fields: lead_source, partner, interest_area, urgency, contact, notes, demo_recording_link.

Jules: Action owners:
- Ravi: marketplace listing + metadata + video coord (owner)
- Maya: benchmark blog + methodology (owner)
- Ivy: webinar ops + legal coordination (owner)
- Nate: landing page + partner email copy + AE one-pager (owner)
- Sam: speakers + demo resource (owner)
- Emma (Skyline): co-branded assets + newsletter promo (partner)

Jules: Please post blockers in this thread. If none, we'll lock the date and start the content sprint. :sparkles:
